sources.articleTitle: 23 dead as minibus collides with trailer truck near Assam's Kaziranga
At least 23 die in bus-truck collision in Assam’s Kaziranga; 20 others injured

headline: Twenty Three People Die Following Bus Collision In Assam India
seoTitle: Bus Collision Results In Twenty Three Deaths In Assam
metaDescription: A collision between a minibus and a trailer truck on National Highway 715 near Kaziranga, India, has resulted in at least 23 confirmed fatalities.
aiSummaryBullets: At least 23 people died after a minibus carrying roughly 40 passengers collided with a trailer truck.
The incident occurred on National Highway 715 located in the Golaghat district near Kaziranga.
State ministers and the Chief Minister of Assam have arrived on-site to oversee relief operations.
aiContextParagraph: A fatal traffic incident occurred on National Highway 715 in the Golaghat district of Assam, India, involving a collision between a minibus and a trailer truck. According to local officials, the minibus was carrying approximately 40 passengers at the time of the crash. Local authorities, including an Executive Magistrate, confirmed that the death toll reached 23, with reports noting that the victims included college students. A significant number of additional individuals sustained injuries and are receiving medical attention. Following the accident, the Chief Minister of Assam and other state representatives traveled to the location to supervise rescue and relief efforts. The process of identifying the deceased individuals is currently ongoing as authorities manage the site and investigate the circumstances surrounding the collision near the Kaziranga area.
whyItIsViral: The event has generated notable regional media coverage across multiple independent news outlets shortly after the incident occurred.
